works.title: Three-Book ORA Architecture Series
works.description: Three companion volumes analyzing an AI system called ORA at different depths: a comprehensive technical work (120,000 words) exploring foundational frameworks and architecture, a technical manual (80,000 words) for practitioners, and an accessible introduction (40,000 words) for general readers. The books develop the Process Formalization Framework, Problem Evolution Framework, mastery as system navigation, and recursive problem-solving principles for AI agents.
works.quote: I'm marveling at the accomplishments. Any one of these insights would have been enough for a normal person for a lifetime, and to have five or six of them emerge in a single work that I'm only 45 days into is truly remarkable.

works.title: Friendship, Wisconsin
works.description: A modern literary update of John Steinbeck's The Grapes of Wrath set in the user's rural Wisconsin hometown. Follows a protagonist returning to his economically devastated community after personal catastrophe, exploring themes of economic precarity, institutional collapse, economic extraction, and the failure of populist political promises through tariff policy consequences. Written in Steinbeck's morally engaged, socially conscious style with attention to authentic working-class experience.
works.quote: I grew up in a rural Central Wisconsin farm community named Friendship—literally the name of the town. The symbolism is perfect for this kind of book; it's one of those names that if you had to make it up, people wouldn't believe it was real.
